title: how to make a pb and j
original:
how to make a pb and j
   1. Get a bag of Dave's Killer Bread from the pantry
   2. Get 1 plate from the cupboard place the plate on the counter
   3. Open the bag of bread
   4. Take out 2 pieces of bread and put both of them on a plate side by side
   5. Get peanut butter out of the pantry and put in next to the plate
   6. Get jelly out of the pantry or fridge and put in next to the peanut butter
   7. Get a butter knife from the drawer and place it next to the jelly
   8. Open the peanut butter lid. 
      8.5 .Then pick up the knife 
   9.         stick the knife blade into the jar
   10. Scope the about 1/8 of a cup of peanut butter
   11. Bring it up out of the peanut butter jar
   12. Bring it to your bred 
   13. Then smear the peanut butter on one flat side of the bread
   14. Get an even coating of peanut butter
   15. Close the peanut butter lid and move it to the cupboard
   16. Open the jelly lid
Then pick up the knife 
   17.         stick the knife blade into the jelly jar
   18. Scope the about 1/8 of a cup of jelly
   19. Bring it up out of the jelly  jar
   20. Bring it to your other bread with nothing on it
   21. Then smear the jelly on one flat side of the other bread
   22. Get an even coating of jelly
   23. Close the jelly lid and then
   24. Put the jelly into the fridge 
   25. Put the knife next to the sink
   26. Take your piece of bread with peanut butter and
27.    Lift it to your piece of bread  with the jelly
28. Put them jelly side to side peanut butter
29. Gently pat them together 
30.Lift to your face and open your mouth
31.Move it into your mouth and bite down

steps.text: Get a bag of Dave's Killer Bread from the pantry

actions.say: A bag of Dave's Killer Bread from the pantry.

steps.note: Pantry, cupboard, drawer and fridge doors open on their own (teacher's rule). The bag of bread stays in Chef Byte's hand: nobody said to put it down.

steps.text: Get 1 plate from the cupboard place the plate on the counter
Open the bag of bread
Take out 2 pieces of bread and put both of them on a plate side by side
steps.note: The bag is open, so 'bread' is now the slices inside it.

steps.text: Get peanut butter out of the pantry and put in next to the plate
Get jelly out of the pantry or fridge and put in next to the peanut butter

actions.say: Jelly. Not in the pantry... in the fridge!

steps.note: 'Pantry or fridge': the jelly was in the fridge.

steps.text: Get a butter knife from the drawer and place it next to the jelly
Open the peanut butter lid.
Then pick up the knife
stick the knife blade into the jar

actions.say: Scoop! About 1/8 of a cup. That is a LOT of peanut butter.

Bring it to your bred
Then smear the peanut butter on one flat side of the bread
Get an even coating of peanut butter
Close the peanut butter lid and move it to the cupboard

actions.say: Into the cupboard it goes. (It came from the pantry, but okay!)

steps.note: Hands full (bag and knife), so the bag of bread goes on the chef hat.

steps.text: Open the jelly lid
Then pick up the knife
steps.note: Unnumbered step. The knife is already in hand.

actions.say: Knife blade into the jelly jar.

steps.text: Scope the about 1/8 of a cup of jelly

actions.say: Scoop! About 1/8 of a cup of jelly.

steps.text: Bring it up out of the jelly  jar
Bring it to your other bread with nothing on it

actions.say: Over to the bread with nothing on it.

steps.text: Then smear the jelly on one flat side of the other bread
Get an even coating of jelly
Close the jelly lid and then
Put the jelly into the fridge
Put the knife next to the sink
Take your piece of bread with peanut butter and

actions.say: Taking the piece with peanut butter.

steps.text: Lift it to your piece of bread  with the jelly

actions.say: Up to the piece with the jelly.

steps.note: 'Jelly side to side peanut butter': flips the peanut butter slice onto the jelly slice so the spreads touch.

steps.text: Put them jelly side to side peanut butter

actions.say: Jelly side to peanut butter side. Flip!

steps.text: Gently pat them together
steps.note: Chef Byte's screen shows an open mouth. The whole plate comes up too, since the sandwich is on it.

steps.text: Lift to your face and open your mouth
steps.note: CHOMP. A bite disappears. Robots can't taste.

steps.text: Move it into your mouth and bite down
